scope: Existing implementation_identity domain/owning-source/selector decision; not narrowed to abstract preference to bypass the full input criterion.
question: Should this field use the qualified frozen runtime content identity or a distinct implementation identity, with the corresponding authenticated owner, canonical selector and byte-verification contract?

options.proposition: Define implementation_identity as the exact current frozen runtime content identity for this consumer field.
options.identity_type: CONTENT_IDENTITY in the runtime domain, only if expressly adopted for this field
options.json_type_proposal: JSON string sha256:<64 lowercase hexadecimal characters>; no coercion
options.selector_proposal: Select /runtime from independently authenticated applicable OperationalContext, then verify referenced exact frozen runtime content bytes under the qualified runtime content-identity rule before projecting that identity. No current value is accepted here.
options.canonicalization_proposal: Serialize the identity string as canonical JSON in the enclosing input body. Do not hash OperationalContext JSON as runtime content; runtime content byte-domain/rule must be independently qualified.
verification_obligations: Authenticate source context and exact target scope/lineage/currentness
Acquire and independently verify frozen runtime bytes under their existing owning content-identity rule
Only after explicit governing choice may runtime identity satisfy implementation_identity; equal SHA-256 spelling alone is insufficient
unknowns: Frozen runtime bytes not acquired or requalified
Current applicability and qualified runtime byte selector not established by reference presence
options.consequences: Would deliberately define a field-level domain relationship; no new equality is inferred now. Runtime changes would affect this field only through the approved rule. Generic constructor hashing does not prove authority or identity equivalence.
options.deferred_fact_limit: Raw runtime byte qualification may remain downstream of a purely conditional domain proposition; this is not permission to waive source proof.

options.proposition: Define implementation_identity as a distinct implementation identity, not interchangeable with runtime identity.
options.identity_type: Distinct implementation domain — exact existing owning identity contract NOT_ESTABLISHED
options.canonical_representation: NOT_ESTABLISHED; do not assume bare SHA-256, authority ID or another path identity
verification_obligations: Identify and authenticate the actual distinct-domain owner and exact identity rule
Specify exact canonical source-to-field selector, byte domain, scope/lineage and freshness proof
Reject runtime/authority/release identity substitution unless separately justified by the adopted contract
options.consequences: Independent implementation evolution and its runtime relation cannot be specified concretely without the owning domain contract. No producer, record name, member or identity prefix is invented.
options.deferred_fact_limit: Cannot mark this complete by promising an unspecified future source: its missing contract determines the representation, selector and meaning being chosen. An abstract preference for distinctness would not satisfy the existing DEC-IMPLEMENTATION question.

missing_decision_inputs.required: For a distinct domain, concrete owning source record/domain and its independently authenticated identity; no such member is established by accepted OperationalContext evidence.
Exact source field or canonical body and byte-to-identity selector for that distinct domain, with scoped applicability and verification rule supported by its source contract.

accepted_findings: Runtime reference remains a reference, not verified frozen runtime bytes or qualified implementation selector.
Constructor requires and hashes the field without defining domain equivalence.
A bounded runtime-domain conditional proposal can be described, but the distinct-domain option lacks its owning source/selector facts.
Complete common dossier predicates cannot pass; DEC-IMPLEMENTATION must remain blocked.

scope_lineage.qualification: Recorded references only; live currentness not asserted.

stop_rule: No new source search, alternative identity-domain investigation, authority issuance, mapping or downstream construction. Missing inputs are recorded for separately authorized receipt/reentry only.
reentry_requirement: New accepted source/contract evidence addressing the named gaps permits a new bounded preparation attempt; the historical result remains unchanged. No automatic retry.
